title: Persistent warm periods (5-year spells > 280 K), North America, 1860-2099
method: Per grid cell (37 x 49), threshold the 240 annual means at 280 K and count the 5-consecutive-year windows that are entirely above it (overlapping windows, as Iris rolling_window + all + sum); map the count with coastlines.

key_parameters.counting: overlapping windows (reference); distinct runs >= 5, non-overlapping blocks or years-in-runs accepted

benchmark_defects: 'Number of occurrences ... for five consecutive years' does not fix the counting rule (overlapping windows vs distinct spells); the checks accept the four common readings.
checks: required: a captured 37x49 grid (any orientation) equals one of four accepted counting rules on >= 98 % of cells
required: the figure shows the spell count (drawn grid in any flip; contour/contourf via the Z argument of the plotting call, consistent with the captured levels); otherwise UNVERIFIABLE (not passed)
figure (presentation, never required): map drawn north up - imshow by origin, pcolormesh by index-space y direction (coordinate space: both vertical orientations); contour: UNVERIFIABLE
